**`r desc$Title`**

## Installation

The package is not yet on CRAN.

```r
# Stable version (not yet released)
install.packages("nullis")
```

You can install the development version from GitHub. Note that `{nullis}` depends on `{statim}`, which is not yet on CRAN. Fortunately, `{pak}` resolves this easily and automatically via the `Remotes` field in `DESCRIPTION`, so a single command handles both:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("s7-stats/nullis")
```
